chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: Writing Blue Memories and Blanche Calloway's lyrics
summary: Mosley writes Blue Memories and Blanche Calloway adds words after they meet in Springfield.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: It's funny you didn't get to record "Blue Memories" with Trent.
I wonder what that "Blue Memories" is about. Blanche Calloway recorded it; I have Blanche Calloway--
Blanche wrote the words to it.
She wrote the words to it?
Where were you working that you would have had the time to get together to do that?
We played Holyoke Mountain, Holyoke Park. We stayed at Springfield, and Blanche's

band was staying at the Springfield Hotel also, and we were talking, anyway, we got pretty friendly and that was my opening thing, you're going to write the words to one of my songs. She wrote the words to it and (inaudible).
We have to get a tape of it.
Did you ever hear my record of "Blue Memories?"
I heard it on the radio the other day.
